_doc: Phase 0 Discovery — Inspects the current Figma file structure. Returns pages, variable collections, components, and styles. Use this BEFORE any creation operation to understand what already exists.
_usage: Send each command sequentially. Combine results into a discovery report.

commands._step: 2. Get all variable collections and counts
3. Get all components in the file

_output.pages: Array of page names and IDs
_output.collections: Variable collections with mode names and variable counts
_output.components: Component names, variants, and property definitions
_output.styles: Paint, text, effect, and grid styles
_output.designSystem: Whether a design system already exists
